title: Summerlin residential stucco
notes: Warm beige stucco (white terracotta), white window trim and sills (smooth quartz), white end-rod window dividers (Detail p.11), gray glass with gray backing (Detail pp.4-5), wood door, clay-tile roof colour (terracotta / granite edge). Mullion here is an end rod, so storefront and curtain-wall components (which need a glass mullion) must not use this palette.
